origin.kind: retrospective user descriptions of browser simulations in a Claude conversation
origin.grouping: seven entries on Oct 16; six on Oct 18, splitting user descriptions 10 and 11 into two named components each

commonDescription.aggregator: simple majority; tie behavior not yet specified
commonDescription.information: empirical-frequency plug-in mutual information, not an exact population certificate
commonDescription.arithmetic: original browser implementation unavailable; exact integer recurrence for a future reconstruction must be declared, not assumed to reproduce JavaScript binary64 multiplication
commonDescription.seeds: 7 for original description 1, 5 for weight generation in description 3; other concrete seeds absent

entries.title: tolerant-k under shared draws
entries.alreadyExists: L7 subset bound, explicit joint-independent convolution, and rejected top-k+1 guarantee already ship.
missingForReconstruction: n,p,k,rho grid and shared-draw act order
entries.limits: rho is the probability of a shared draw, not a correlation coefficient. Keep declared common probability space and valid p_i. Finite trials are not a proof.

entries.title: phase-defect sweep
entries.alreadyExists: L8 already records odd/even extrema and full/nonzero shift domains.
missingForReconstruction: n bound of the browser sweep
entries.limits: The described p<=n sweep is broader than the published p|n domain. Nondivisors do not inherit L8. T87 is separate.

entries.title: weighted mix versus named fork
entries.alreadyExists: L9 noninjectivity and H(configuration | mix) with explicit prior already ship.
entries.limits: A complete enumeration does not make an undeclared prior uniform. Partition entropy is not conditional information loss.

entries.title: majority versus origins
entries.alreadyExists: Existing capacity/decision procedures separate posterior information, decision information and accuracy. M/3 is only a conditional antecedent.
entries.limits: No exact generator equivalence is established. Do not edit or reimplement M/3 or M/4.

entries.title: self-bifurcation
entries.classification: descriptive experiment; no exact published match
entries.alreadyExists: L9 supplies a different, prior-dependent conditional entropy measure; it is not this experiment.
entries.limits: Partition entropy versus majority error establishes neither a law nor recoverable attribution.

entries.title: oracle cofailure subgroup recovery
entries.alreadyExists: coincidenceExcess already measures false coincidence relative to a declared reference, with truth.
entries.limits: The no-oracle counterpart is not this published API. Recovery requires max outside < theta < min inside; a mean threshold and finite successful run are insufficient.

entries.title: dissent ledger
entries.alreadyExists: L9 already distinguishes conditional information loss under a prior from entropy of a partition.
missingForReconstruction: exact act sequence and prior, if a new descriptive experiment is desired
entries.limits: Excluded as an algebraic law. No destroyed admissibility field, M/4 change or attribution claim follows.

entries.title: unanimity curve and partial subcauses
entries.alreadyExists: fitUnanimityModel already fits the declared single-lineage unanimity curve without truth, with explicit p grid and nonidentification outcomes.
missingForReconstruction: K,c,e,A,seed,trials,partial activation joint law and precedence
entries.limits: Two subcauses are not automatically the fitter model. Shared-all cause mass is not identified from arbitrary partial causes; preserve ambiguity.

entries.title: lineage ceiling
entries.alreadyExists: capacityP0 already gives log2(n)-h(c)-c*log2(n-1) at private p=0; capacityBound and mutualInformation cover distinct conditions.
missingForReconstruction: n,c,e,K grid,seed,tie rule,exact order of shared/private channels and claimed Markov chain
entries.limits: Always-wrong active cause does not imply private p=0. Single-dominant-factor n=2,c=1/2,p=1/10,K=1 has positive I while capacityP0 gives zero. Proposed bottleneck needs T->lineage-channel->observations with no extra truth access. F1 is law/thm-extremal on a finite uniform partition lattice; do not identify its RI_H with observation-channel mutual information.

entries.title: coordinated liars
entries.alreadyExists: Existing conditional information and false-coincidence procedures are antecedents, not an exact match.
missingForReconstruction: K,L,f,seed,trials,truth generation,error labels and activation ordering
entries.limits: n=6,e=.2 alone do not define the joint law. Common-mode observational agreement is not identification of a shared causal mechanism.

entries.title: sleeper
entries.alreadyExists: The existing binary channel already refutes linear-in-f information damage: f=.01 loses h(f)~.080793 bits.
entries.limits: No generic h(f) bound is asserted for arbitrary n=6 majority. Detector nondetection is not a damage bound.

entries.title: pairwise cofailure
entries.alreadyExists: Reuse oracle coincidence counts and declared reference computations where contracts match.
entries.limits: Two groups of four and n=6 do not establish subgroup recovery. No-oracle observed-answer coincidence requires its own reference contract for Head; coincidenceExcess requires truth.

entries.title: marginal information by addition order
entries.alreadyExists: Existing mutualInformation/decisionInformation distinguish information objects; no exact arbitrary-subset joint-law API match is claimed.
missingForReconstruction: two explicit orders,subset joint tables,c,e,seed,trials and comparable-quality condition
entries.limits: Delta I=I(truth;new source | previous). Distinct lineage does not guarantee a larger increment. Same data and full joint law must be retained across orders.

meet.alreadyKnown: fixed static meet permutation invariance is already declared; current work formalizes the interval instance and observable empty-cell equivalence, not a new algebraic operation

T38.scope: finite nonempty closed real intervals have Helly-2; arbitrary forms do not inherit it

F1.status: published identity located; relation to lineage ceiling remains gate-3 work
F1.scope: finite uniformly weighted partition lattice, RI_H extremal log2(n)-2+2/n; this is not an observation-channel I(truth;aggregate) bound

noOracleContract.observable: answer coincidence relative to an explicit reference; not false coincidence or causal identification

standing: inventory and preparation only; original experiments have no receipts, no status is promoted
